concerns.text: FR-002 mandates subsampling when memory usage exceeds 7 GB, but Acceptance Scenario 2 states the system must raise an error and halt execution in that case, creating a direct contradiction about how overflow should be handled.

Functional Requirements refer to "US-1", "US-2", and "US-3", but the specification defines the user stories as "User Story 1", "User Story 2", and "User Story 3". The mismatched identifiers break traceability and constitute an unstable terminology issue.
